Ravi: Quick heads-up from sampleapp playthrough: two irritations that together caused a customer-facing issue. SDK isn't honoring Retry-After when it's a string, and the Node quickstart uses `model_name` while SDK serializes `model` only. End result: immediate retries + quiet fallback to a bigger model. Anyone seen this combo?
Nina (DevEx): Which SDK and sampleapp? can you paste minimal logs?
Ravi: node-quickstart v0.7.0, sdk-js v1.4.2. Example 429 header we get: `Retry-After: "10"`. SDK retries right away. Log snippet: ```[2024-02-02T15:12:01Z] 429 /v1/generate Retry-After: "10" -> retrying```.
Omar (Infra): Ah, that's from an edge cache that serializes headers as strings. We intended Retry-After to be parsed leniently. If SDK does strict int parsing it will ignore it.
Priya (Support): This bit caused a Dedicated customer outage — their traffic hit a larger fallback model (which costs ~3x) and they noticed a spike. Ticket SUP-8712 created.
Ravi: Also node quickstart example code uses: `client.generate({ model_name: 'redwood-large', prompt })` but SDK's request builder maps only `model`, so model_name gets dropped. REST accepts `model_name` and `model` interchangeably, so the sampleapp looked fine when testing directly against REST, but the SDK path silently dropped the intended model.
Nina (DevEx): That's bad UX. We should: 1) make Retry-After parsing accept quoted numbers and floats and honor seconds; 2) implement alias mapping in the JS serializer so `model_name` -> `model`; 3) add an automated quickstart smoke test that runs sampleapp and verifies the model used in the request.
Omar (Infra): I'll change edge to emit unquoted Retry-After where possible, but SDK must be defensive.
Priya (Support): For the customer I'll attach a timeline and rollback options. Also they were rotating tokens frequently and reported intermittent 401s; is the SDK caching the token provider result too aggressively?
Ravi: Yep repro: we pass `async () => await vault.get('svc-token')` as token provider, but SDK calls it once at init and reuses the value. If provider rotates tokens every 60s we get 401s until process restart. My repro: https://github.com/redwood/repro-quickstart-token-cache.
Nina (DevEx): Fix idea: SDK should call provider on each request or at least on a 401/403 to refresh. We should make this configurable (cache duration) but default to calling provider every attempt for providers that return a promise.
ci-bot: test-suite:quickstart-smoke failed on 1729991111 - rate-limit assertions triggered.
Ravi: Proposed owner list: @Nina patch Retry-After & token-provider behavior, @Omar adjust edge header formatting, add unit+integration tests, and update quickstart docs to recommend provider functions that fetch fresh tokens. I'll open three small PRs and tag support for customer comms.
Nina (DevEx): Sounds good. I'll include a changelog note and a small sample snippet showing correct token provider usage: ```const getToken = async () => { return await vault.fetch('svc-token'); }; // call per-request```
Priya (Support): Thanks. I'll keep SUP-8712 updated and ask for credit/compensation options.
